title: EK21 sheet
blurb: VIA for remaps (Calculator on Tab). FN layer still handles RGB and wireless. USB JSON and 2.4 GHz JSON are different files.
footer: via-browser-connect already lists EK21 as 36b0:3066. Snap Chromium will not open hidraw.

groups.label: RGB
groups.hint: 18 onboard effects — no Windows app needed

groups.label: System
groups.hint: OS swap, Win lock, factory reset

combos.title: Calculator
combos.detail: VIA remap. USB-C, via-browser-connect, usevia.app, Epomaker EK21 USB JSON (not the 2.4 GHz file). Special → Calculator (KC_CALC). Swap the Calc keycap.

combos.title: Cycle backlight
combos.detail: Onboard lighting modes. Does not need VIA.

combos.title: Saturation up
combos.detail: Onboard. VIA can also paint per-key RGB.

combos.title: Bluetooth 1
combos.detail: Short press reconnects. VIA config still wants USB or 2.4 GHz, not Bluetooth.

combos.title: Bluetooth 2
combos.detail: Short press reconnects. Hold 3s to pair.

combos.title: Bluetooth 3
combos.detail: Short press reconnects. Hold 3s to pair.

combos.title: 2.4 GHz
combos.detail: Load the 2.4 GHz VIA JSON if you configure over the dongle. USB JSON for the cable.

combos.title: Reset pad
combos.detail: Factory reset the numpad. Does not wipe the OS.

lightsOut.copy: FN+Backspace toggles pad lights. Num Lock stays on.

steps: Load Epomaker EK21 USB JSON if the Design tab is empty.
